plan: The plan will install loft insulation, then cavity wall insulation, then double glazing, followed by a smart thermostat, a heat pump and finally solar panels. This order is chosen because insulation and glazing reduce the heat the pump needs to supply, and solar panels are added last as they only cut grid electricity.

Each measure’s saving is worked out on the energy left after the previous measures, so the figures already reflect how they interact.
